name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
why: Center-of-band low-carb beef bake (535 cal / 9 g carbs / 28 g protein published on Budget Bytes). Structurally low-carb: steak + peppers + mushrooms + provolone, no rice/potato/pasta base. Bakeable and weigh-and-divide friendly at 14 servings. Shaved beef steak rebuilds cleanly on sirloin-steak; provolone maps to sliced-cheese; every ingredient has a board home. Distinct from existing philly-cheesesteak-skillet-bowls (rice-bowl skillet). Note: 44 g fat is heavy (4 Tbsp butter + 1/4 cup oil for 4 servings) - our computed calories may drop below source if fat is trimmed, keeping it safely mid-band.
